messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: service=hosted-inference (PD-223344) fired. Escalation policy= inference-sre. Primary oncall (jade) acknowledged but no in-thread follow-up; after escalation timeout paging secondary (alex) and manager (lina). PD link: https://pd.example/PD-223344

incidentbot: Thread created in #incidents. Tags: impact=customer-facing, region=us-west-2, severity=high. Please respond in-channel when you take ownership.

jade: acked. I started a quick check but I'm on transit, phone DND intermittently. Will try to confirm by voice in 2m.

pagerduty-bot: Note: Primary ack is present but no heartbeat update -> escalation to secondary as per policy (timeout 4m).

alex: picking it up — checking dashboards and autoscale events.

sam-support: Support queue shows 3 high-priority customer cases citing 503s from 10:03-10:11 UTC in us-west-2. Case IDs: CS-9011, CS-9012, CS-9013.

alex: running baseline health endpoint ->
```
curl -sS https://hosted-inference-usw2.internal/health | jq .
# result: {"status":"degraded","error_rate":0.22,"tail_latency_p95_ms":1240}
```

alex: checking infra -> host pool runtime-pool-usw2 has 2 nodes at 100% mem, 1 host (runtime-7) showing OOM events and repeated kernel fallbacks.

jade: (via dm) I'm briefly reachable — DND cleared, standing by.

incidentbot: PD escalation also paged manager (lina) due to policy escalation. Manager paged at 10:15 UTC.

lina: joining. Summarize impact and proposed mitigations?

alex: impact: sustained 5xx (mainly 503/504) for subset of requests to hosted-inference in us-west-2. Customer-visible errors for enterprise tenants. Root suspect: quantized model variant causing memory pressure + kernel selector falling back leading to tail latency and upstream timeouts.

jade: that matches the canary note this morning — small quantization change deployed at 09:40. We flagged but it passed basic functional tests. Perf test missed tail-memory spike.

alex: mitigation options: 1) immediate traffic shift to regional replica (us-east-1) for affected customers, 2) scale up pool by adding 2 nodes (possible but slower due to quotas), 3) temporarily pin routing to previous model variant (pre-quant). Fastest is routing change.

alex: applying routing fallback now -> command:
```
redwoodctl route set --service hosted-inference --fallback-region us-east-1 --selector "model_variant!=quant-v2" --force
```

incidentbot: routing change accepted and being rolled out at edge. Propagation estimate ~30-60s.

alex: after reroute health: 
```
{"status":"degraded","error_rate":0.08,"tail_latency_p95_ms":980}
```

sam-support: Notifying affected customers: sending status update that we're routing traffic to a stable region while we investigate.

product-notify-bot: Broadcast to #product and #support: "Incident PD-223344: elevated 5xx rate in us-west-2; temporary traffic reroute to us-east-1 applied; mitigation in progress. Will update in 15m."

lina: good. Alex, coordinate rollback of model variant if the reroute doesn't reduce error rate to <2%. Also prepare canary rollback plan.

alex: noted. Trying a graceful restart of runtime-7 to free leaked memory after traffic drains: 
```
kubectl cordon runtime-7
kubectl drain runtime-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n hosted-inference
```

alex: restart succeeded, runtime-7 rejoined. Post-restart health: 
```
{"status":"healthy","error_rate":0.03,"tail_latency_p95_ms":870}
```

jade: nice work. Are autoscale events suppressed? I saw a failed scale attempt earlier due to cloud quota error in the controller logs. If we think memory pressure will recur, revise quota request.

alex: yes, autoscaler showed "scale blocked: quota-limit" at 10:08. I'm opening a low-priority infra ticket to increase reserved capacity for us-west-2 while we sort model variant.

lina: messaging: escalate to exec only if error rate >10% sustained or if customers report data loss. Otherwise continue monitoring. Postmortem required — include canary perf test gap.

sam-support: customers updated: "Mitigation in place; traffic routed to alternate region; team validating."

incidentbot: PD escalation will stop paging manager since mitigation acknowledged and progress made.

alex: next steps: 1) keep routing fallback for 30m, 2) run perf repro on quant-v2 in a canary env with increased load, 3) if repro confirms regression, trigger model rollback (pre-quant). I'll own 1&2, jade to own rollback if needed.

jade: will standby for rollback and coordinate release engineer.

lina: please post updates every 10m. Also include timeline and decision criteria for rollback in the incident tracker.

alex: linking dashboards and logs: https://dashboards.redwood/hosted-inference/PD-223344 , and kube logs gist: https://logs.redwood/g/PD-223344

sam-support: closing customer notifications as "mitigation in place". Will reopen if errors resurface.

product-notify-bot: Reminder: add a quick perf regression check to canary pipeline for quantized variants (owner: research/qa).

jade: creating postmortem ticket INC-223344-RCA and adding initial owners/notes.

incidentbot: Incident PD-223344 status: Mitigated -> monitoring. Thread archived to incident tracker.

lina: thanks everyone — please update the postmortem with timeline and the quota action item.

alex: monitoring continues; will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
